style_guide.purpose: Consistent recipe image generation for a clean, modern recipe app

background.mood: clean, crisp, minimal — no clutter or props

composition.framing: full dish in frame, natural table view
composition.subject: food served and plated on a clean white plate
composition.focus: sharp focus across the entire dish
composition.angle: 45 degree angle — natural eye-level table perspective
composition.negative_space: tablecloth visible generously around the plate

style.post_processing: clean and minimal — no heavy filters or vignettes

plating.garnish: minimal and intentional — one simple garnish at most

cutlery.placement: naturally placed beside the plate — fork on the left, knife and spoon on the right

extras.quantity: maximum 2 extra props — keep the scene uncluttered
